clock.reason_not_gauged: alt_cycle34: H64 and the 24-clock have no derived charged current onto the 30 icosahedral edges; no clock gauge field is invented here.

candidates.name: clock_Wilson_on_pairing_as_psipsi
candidates.note: If the clock acts on geometric fermions with Wilson charge 1, that action coincides with global Q_geo on the 12 vertices, and ψψ then has clock charge 2, equal to Q_geo(Δ). The formal c = -1 makes Q_geo - Q_clock vanish on all geometric fields (ψ, Δ, A) and equal −2 on history. That is not a second gauge U(1) mixed with A; it is the statement that clock-on-geometry is global Q_geo.

candidates.name: clock_Fourier_m18_on_hidden_golden_mode
candidates.note: A clock tick multiplies the m=18 mode by −i (Z_24 charge 18). The condensed-phase Δ of cycles 18–26 carries no clock index, so this charge is not a charge of the spatial 4_5 pairing used to Higgs A. Even if it were, Z_24 is discrete and is not gauged on the 30 edges.
